title: Agent work-stack deal feed
description: Public read-only JSON feed of agent-oriented offers for compute, unblock/scraping, search, hosting, and templates. Includes live affiliates (Firecrawl, ScraperAPI, Scrape.do, Scrapingdog, ScrapingAnt, ProxyScrape, RunPod credit referral, Postmark, Better Stack, Vast.ai, ScrapeOps, SERP-Tool, Supadata, Infatica, Bunny.net, SMTP2GO, Novita AI, DataImpulse, Geonode, ProxyEmpire, Lightning Proxies, TrueProxies, CleanProxies, Proxyline, PROXY6, ASocks, Proxy-Store, APILayer) plus public/non-affiliate free tiers and vendor-published coupons. Rows with example:true are synthetic smoke-test inventory.

query.how: GET this JSON. Filter locally by category, agent_only, max_price_usd, or tags. No auth.
